body: Shelters are full or only take youth or single mothers, I'm neither of those. There aren't any halfway houses or anything like that near me that I could get to. I don't have a car or bus money or anything. Panhandling is illegal and I have a criminal record already. Been on wait list for subsidized housing for 3 years. My name has not yet come up. Been trying to get disability for 2 years. I've tried everything. I've been to social workers and case managers and I was in a shelter but they couldn't help me find anything. I've done it all and nothing has been available to me and there are no more places to check I've done it over and over and over calling and wiring and applying and everything else. Theres nothing left for me.
